records.notes: Visible madd, final hamza, and stopping-mark differences in جَاءَ are preserved without subtype assertion.
Hafs visibly uses أَنْجَانَا while the other forms use أَنْجَيْتَنَا.
Difference is initial hamza/alif and stopping-mark presentation in ءَالِهَةً; no subtype asserted.
Hafs visibly uses وَزَكَرِيَّا while the other editions use وَزَكَرِيَّاءَ.
Visible forms differ in initial hamza/alif and pronoun-mark presentation; no subtype asserted.
